lines.zh: 沙丘松软，我的蹄子陷进去半寸。
lines.en: The dune is soft; my hooves sink half an inch.

lines.zh: 我沿着沙脊走，影子被拉得很长。
lines.en: I walk the crest of the dune, my shadow stretched long.

lines.zh: 一步一步，我踩着昨天的脚印。
lines.en: Step by step, I follow yesterday's own tracks.

lines.zh: 风把沙吹进我的睫毛，我照样走。
lines.en: Sand blows into my lashes; I keep walking anyway.

lines.zh: 驼峰里的存粮还够走两天。
lines.en: The fat in my hump will last two more days.

lines.zh: 我不急，沙漠最不缺的就是时间。
lines.en: No hurry — the desert has time to spare.

lines.zh: 四个人并排走，我一步就跨过去。
lines.en: Four men abreast — I cross that in one stride.

lines.zh: 沙面下有硬石，我的蹄子听得出来。
lines.en: There's rock under the sand; my hooves can hear it.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，可从不停下。
lines.en: I go slow, and never once halt.

lines.zh: 我身后留下一串深深的蹄印。
lines.en: A line of deep hoofprints trails behind me.

lines.zh: 正午的沙烫脚，我挑阴影走。
lines.en: The noon sand burns; I pick the shaded path.

lines.zh: 两个骑手坐上来，我的步子也不乱。
lines.en: Two riders on my back, and my gait stays even.

lines.zh: 沙子进了鼻子，我打个响鼻继续走。
lines.en: Sand in my nose — one snort and I walk on.

lines.zh: 我认得回家的路，沙丘挪了也认得。
lines.en: I know the way home, even when dunes move.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的影子走，太阳太正。
lines.en: I walk on my own shadow. The sun is straight up.

lines.zh: 我站在太阳底下，一动不动。
lines.en: I stand in the sun without moving a muscle.

lines.zh: 反刍的时候，我慢慢磨着牙。
lines.en: While I chew my cud, my teeth grind slowly.

lines.zh: 风停了，沙也安静下来。
lines.en: The wind drops, and the sand goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我抬起长睫毛，看远处的热浪。
lines.en: I lift my long lashes and watch the heat shimmer.

lines.zh: 驼峰歪了一下，我把重心挪回来。
lines.en: My hump shifts; I settle my weight back.

lines.zh: 沙漠里没什么可看，我还是看着。
lines.en: There's nothing to see out here, and I look anyway.

lines.zh: 我慢慢跪下，又觉得没必要。
lines.en: I start to kneel, then decide against it.

lines.zh: 远处有只兔子，它比我还紧张。
lines.en: A rabbit in the distance is more nervous than I am.

lines.zh: 我甩甩尾巴，赶走一只沙蝇。
lines.en: I flick my tail and brush off a sandfly.

lines.zh: 站久了，蹄子下面会陷出小坑。
lines.en: Standing this long, my hooves sink small pits.

lines.zh: 我把嘴边的沙子吐掉，继续等。
lines.en: I spit out the grit and keep waiting.

lines.zh: 太阳偏西了，我还是这个姿势。
lines.en: The sun has shifted west; I hold the same pose.

lines.zh: 枯灌木的影子够我遮住眼睛。
lines.en: A dead bush's shadow is enough to shade my eyes.

lines.zh: 我听着风，判断今晚会不会起沙暴。
lines.en: I listen to the wind to guess if a sandstorm comes.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在沙上，眯一会。
lines.en: I rest my chin on the sand and squint a while.

lines.zh: 你站得离我太近，我先闻闻你。
lines.en: You're standing too close; let me sniff you first.

lines.zh: 你手里没拿缰绳，是想骑我吗？
lines.en: No reins in your hand — do you mean to ride me?

lines.zh: 我的背能坐两个人，你要带谁？
lines.en: My back seats two; who are you bringing along?

lines.zh: 你身上有仙人掌的味道。
lines.en: You smell faintly of cactus.

lines.zh: 要装箱子就直说，别摸我驼峰。
lines.en: If you want a chest, just say so — don't poke my hump.

lines.zh: 你把鞍放在沙上，我看见了。
lines.en: You set the saddle in the sand; I saw it.

lines.zh: 我低头，把鼻尖凑到你肩边。
lines.en: I lower my head and nuzzle your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你的水壶快空了，我闻得出来。
lines.en: Your waterskin is nearly empty — I can smell it.

lines.zh: 你看着我的眼睛，我眨得很慢。
lines.en: You look into my eyes; I blink very slowly.

lines.zh: 别站在我后面，我会踢。
lines.en: Stay out of my rear; those hooves kick.

lines.zh: 我等你先伸手，才肯低头。
lines.en: I wait for your hand before lowering my head.

lines.zh: 你带的枯灌木是给我的吗？
lines.en: Is that dead bush for me?

lines.zh: 两个骑手，一前一后，你坐哪边？
lines.en: Two riders, front and back — which seat is yours?

lines.zh: 我认得你的声音，昨天你也来过。
lines.en: I know your voice; you came yesterday too.

lines.zh: 你从椰子树那边过来，我看见了。
lines.en: You came from the palms. I saw you.

lines.zh: 你站上风处，你的味道先到。
lines.en: You stand upwind. Your smell arrives first.

lines.zh: 你把鞍垫抖了两下，我懂。
lines.en: You shake the saddle pad twice. Understood.

lines.zh: 你走开三步，我又低头吃草。
lines.en: Three steps off, and I go back to the grass.

lines.zh: 你摸我的鼻梁，我不躲。
lines.en: You touch my nose bridge. I do not pull away.

lines.zh: 你看我的驼峰，那里不装箱。
lines.en: You look at my hump. The chest goes elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我闷哼一声，往旁边挪了半步。
lines.en: I grunt once and shift half a step aside.

lines.zh: 皮厚也疼，只是我不叫出声。
lines.en: Thick hide still hurts; I just don't cry out.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，沙从耳朵里落下。
lines.en: I shake my head; sand falls from my ears.

lines.zh: 这伤不重，我还能站着。
lines.en: The wound's not deep; I can still stand.

lines.zh: 我护住驼峰，往后退。
lines.en: I shield my hump and back away.

lines.zh: 我喘得厉害，蹄子有点发抖。
lines.en: My breath is rough and my hooves tremble.

lines.zh: 别打了，我身上还有箱子。
lines.en: Stop hitting me — there's a chest on my back.

lines.zh: 我低下头，把长睫毛垂下来。
lines.en: I lower my head and let my lashes fall.

lines.zh: 痛是痛，我一步也没退远。
lines.en: It hurts, but I haven't backed far.

lines.zh: 我的驼峰缩了，看着矮了半截。
lines.en: My hump sags and I look half my height.

lines.zh: 那丛枯灌木，我一口就能卷走。
lines.en: That dead bush — I could roll it up in one bite.

lines.zh: 仙人掌有刺，我还是想咬一口。
lines.en: The cactus has spines, and I still want a bite.

lines.zh: 你把枯枝举高，我的脖子跟着抬。
lines.en: You raise the dry branch; my neck follows it up.

lines.zh: 仙人掌果的甜味飘过来了。
lines.en: The sweetness of a cactus fruit drifts over.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，几乎够到你的手。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and nearly reach your hand.

lines.zh: 那果子是留着配对的，我记住了。
lines.en: That fruit is for courting; I've noted it.

lines.zh: 枯灌木的叶子一碰就碎，真香。
lines.en: The dry bush crumbles at a touch, and smells wonderful.

lines.zh: 我咽了口唾沫，声音很响。
lines.en: I swallow, and it is loud.

lines.zh: 你先放下，我再慢慢过来。
lines.en: Set it down first; I'll come over slowly.

lines.zh: 带刺的东西，我嚼得比谁都稳。
lines.en: Spined things — I chew them steadier than anyone.

lines.zh: 我闻到果汁，蹄子自己往前挪。
lines.en: I smell the juice, and my hooves move on their own.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我才肯靠近。
lines.en: Step back once, and only then will I approach.

lines.zh: 那点绿色在沙里太显眼了。
lines.en: That bit of green stands out in all this sand.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，又怕咬到你的袖子。
lines.en: I open my mouth, then fear biting your sleeve.

lines.zh: 那根仙人掌还带着刺，我照样要。
lines.en: That cactus still has spines. I want it anyway.

lines.zh: 你把枯灌木掰成两半，我听见了。
lines.en: You snap the dead bush in two. I heard.

lines.zh: 甜味飘到沙丘顶，我抬脚了。
lines.en: The sweetness reaches the dune top. I move.

lines.zh: 撞到我像撞一堵会动的墙。
lines.en: Bumping me is like bumping a moving wall.

lines.zh: 我侧过身子，给你让出半步。
lines.en: I turn sideways and give you half a step.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我转身慢，尾巴扫到你了。
lines.en: Sorry — I turn slowly, and my tail caught you.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀只到我的膝盖。
lines.en: Your shoulder only reaches my knee.

lines.zh: 我停住，怕踩到你的脚。
lines.en: I stop, afraid of stepping on your feet.

lines.zh: 沙地滑，我们俩都没站稳。
lines.en: The sand slips, and neither of us keeps footing.

lines.zh: 我的驼峰碰到你，别介意。
lines.en: My hump brushed you — don't mind it.

lines.zh: 这么大个子，转身得绕一圈。
lines.en: An animal this size needs a circle to turn.

lines.zh: 你退后些，我的膝盖会顶人。
lines.en: Back up a little; my knees can knock.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，扬起一团沙。
lines.en: We collide and kick up a puff of sand.

lines.zh: 仙人掌果一人一半，甜得很。
lines.en: One cactus fruit, split in two — very sweet.

lines.zh: 她的睫毛比我的还长。
lines.en: Her lashes are longer than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，驼峰轻轻碰着。
lines.en: We walk side by side, humps gently touching.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子蹭她的脖子，她没躲。
lines.en: I nuzzle her neck, and she doesn't pull away.

lines.zh: 沙漠里两只骆驼，影子并成一个。
lines.en: Two camels in the desert, shadows merging into one.

lines.zh: 她咬了一口果子，又把剩下的推给我。
lines.en: She takes a bite, then pushes the rest to me.

lines.zh: 我们对着夕阳站了很久。
lines.en: We stood facing the sunset for a long while.

lines.zh: 以后这片沙丘归我们俩走。
lines.en: From now on, these dunes are ours to walk.

lines.zh: 她的驼峰比我的高一点。
lines.en: Her hump stands a little taller than mine.

lines.zh: 等小骆驼出生，我教它找枯灌木。
lines.en: When the calf comes, I'll teach it to find dead bushes.

lines.zh: 我叼起那根枯枝，放进箱子里。
lines.en: I pick up the dry branch and drop it in the chest.

lines.zh: 地上有个东西，我用嘴唇夹起来。
lines.en: Something's on the ground; I pinch it with my lips.

lines.zh: 箱子满了，我只能叼在嘴里。
lines.en: The chest is full, so I carry it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，我也找得到。
lines.en: Even something this small, I can find.

lines.zh: 我低头捡，驼峰晃了一下。
lines.en: I dip my head to pick it up; my hump sways.

lines.zh: 捡来的东西都归你，我不留。
lines.en: Whatever I pick up is yours; I keep nothing.

lines.zh: 我把它含稳，免得被风吹走。
lines.en: I hold it steady so the wind can't take it.

lines.zh: 这件东西要放进鞍袋里。
lines.en: This one belongs in the saddlebag.

lines.zh: 我用蹄子拨了拨，再低头叼起。
lines.en: I nudge it with a hoof, then lower my head.

lines.zh: 捡东西这事，骆驼也做得来。
lines.en: Picking things up — a camel can manage that too.

lines.zh: 沙丘那边有片绿，我看见了。
lines.en: There's green beyond the dune; I see it.

lines.zh: 风里有水的味道，很淡。
lines.en: There's water on the wind — very faint.

lines.zh: 远处那丛东西，像是枯灌木。
lines.en: That clump in the distance looks like a dead bush.

lines.zh: 有东西在沙上闪了一下。
lines.en: Something flashed on the sand.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，耳朵先转过去。
lines.en: I raise my head; my ears turn first.

lines.zh: 沙面在动，下面藏着什么。
lines.en: The sand surface moves; something hides beneath.

lines.zh: 那不是海市蜃楼，我真看见了。
lines.en: That's no mirage — I truly saw it.

lines.zh: 我盯住那个方向，不再眨眼。
lines.en: I fix on that direction and stop blinking.

lines.zh: 有只动物在挖沙，我过去看看。
lines.en: An animal is digging; I'll go take a look.

lines.zh: 味道从南边来，我记下了。
lines.en: The scent comes from the south; I've marked it.

lines.zh: 我一步一步靠近，不惊动它。
lines.en: I close in step by step without startling it.

lines.zh: 沙子太响，我放轻了蹄子。
lines.en: The sand is loud; I soften my hooves.

lines.zh: 它还没发现我，我绕到下风口。
lines.en: It hasn't noticed me; I circle downwind.

lines.zh: 我压低脖子，驼峰还是那么高。
lines.en: I lower my neck, though my hump stays tall.

lines.zh: 风帮我盖住了脚步声。
lines.en: The wind covers the sound of my steps.

lines.zh: 那东西开始动了，我也停下。
lines.en: It starts to move, so I stop too.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，眼睛一眨不眨。
lines.en: I stare at it without blinking once.

lines.zh: 前面是硬地，走过去不会有印。
lines.en: Hard ground ahead — my steps won't leave prints.

lines.zh: 我绕开那丛仙人掌，继续跟。
lines.en: I skirt that cactus and keep following.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就能看清了。
lines.en: A little closer and I'll see it clearly.

lines.zh: 我前蹄离地，落下时重重砸。
lines.en: I rear up and bring my forelegs down.

lines.zh: 骆驼也会咬，牙齿不软。
lines.en: Camels bite too, and my teeth aren't soft.

lines.zh: 我往后一踢，沙都飞起来了。
lines.en: I kick backward and the sand flies up.

lines.zh: 别怪我，是你先动的手。
lines.en: Don't blame me — you swung first.

lines.zh: 我把嘴里的东西吐出去，才动手。
lines.en: I spit out what I was carrying before I strike.

lines.zh: 这一下很重，我的膝盖先到。
lines.en: This one lands heavy; my knee gets there first.

lines.zh: 我冲过去，用整个身子撞。
lines.en: I charge in and hit with my whole body.

lines.zh: 打完了，我退两步看着你。
lines.en: It's done; I back off two steps and watch you.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩下去，像砸石头。
lines.en: My hoof comes down like a hammer on stone.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把角一样的东西顶过去。
lines.en: I swing my head and drive my brow at you.

lines.zh: 天刚亮，我从沙里站起来。
lines.en: At first light I rise out of the sand.

lines.zh: 四周全是沙丘，没有一棵树。
lines.en: Dunes on every side, and not a single tree.

lines.zh: 我的第一口早餐是枯灌木。
lines.en: My first breakfast is a dead bush.

lines.zh: 太阳照在驼峰上，暖得发烫。
lines.en: The sun on my hump grows warm, then hot.

lines.zh: 我抖掉背上的沙，站直了。
lines.en: I shake the sand off my back and stand tall.

lines.zh: 这地方太干，正合我的脾气。
lines.en: This place is dry — exactly my temperament.

lines.zh: 我第一次闻到仙人掌的味道。
lines.en: For the first time I smell a cactus.

lines.zh: 远处有队伍经过，我躲到沙丘后。
lines.en: A caravan passes far off; I duck behind a dune.

lines.zh: 我的腿还很软，走了两步才稳。
lines.en: My legs are weak; two steps steady them.

lines.zh: 沙子灌进蹄缝，我甩了甩。
lines.en: Sand fills the gaps in my hooves; I shake it out.

lines.zh: 从今天起，我就在这片沙漠走动。
lines.en: From today, I walk this stretch of desert.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，蓝得没有一点云。
lines.en: I look up: the sky is blue without a cloud.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到我的毛，焦味很冲。
lines.en: Flames lick my coat; the burnt smell is sharp.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘上滚下去，撞进沙里。
lines.en: I tumble off the dune and crash into sand.

lines.zh: 水比沙子难对付，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Water is harder than sand; I can't stay up.

lines.zh: 轰的一声，沙像雨一样落下来。
lines.en: A blast, and sand rains down on me.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的侧面，很细。
lines.en: Something thin has lodged in my side.

lines.zh: 紫色的光缠住腿，我迈不开步。
lines.en: Violet light wraps my legs; I can't step.

lines.zh: 驼峰空了，我饿得走不动。
lines.en: My hump is empty and I'm too hungry to walk.

lines.zh: 雷打在我脚边，沙变成了玻璃。
lines.en: Lightning strikes by my feet and sand turns to glass.

lines.zh: 底下没有沙，只有一直往下掉。
lines.en: No sand below — only a long fall.
